classification.difficultyReason: Coordinate three unknown integers so that all three endpoint sums hold simultaneously.

content.prompt: The integers on the edges of each triangle below are given by the sum of integers which are to be placed in the circles. Find the numbers in the circles.

spec.description: Upright triangle with three writable white vertex circles. Edge labels lie outside their corresponding edges.
spec.mathematics: Top plus bottom-left equals -1; top plus bottom-right equals -6; bottom-left plus bottom-right equals -9.
spec.answerVisibility: All three vertex circles are blank.

answer.worked:
Try a pair of integers with sum $-9$ in the bottom circles, and test whether both sloping edges give the same top value. The pair $-2,-7$ gives top value $1$.

Check all three edges:
$$\begin{align*}1+(-2)&=-1\\1+(-7)&=-6\\-2+(-7)&=-9\end{align*}$$

spec.description: Complete triangle with all three circles filled.
spec.mathematics: Top 1, bottom-left -2, bottom-right -7; edge sums -1, -6 and -9.
spec.answerVisibility: Completed vertex values appear only in the solution.

Check all three edges:
$$\begin{align*}-1+0&=-1\\-1+(-6)&=-7\\0+(-6)&=-6\end{align*}$$

spec.mathematics: Top plus bottom-left equals 0; top plus bottom-right equals -18; bottom-left plus bottom-right equals -34.
spec.answerVisibility: All three vertex circles are blank.

answer.worked:
The left edge has sum $0$, so its two circle values are opposites. Try opposite values and use the bottom sum $-34$ to find the bottom-right value. Top $8$ and bottom-left $-8$ give bottom-right $-26$, which also satisfies the right edge.

Check all three edges:
$$\begin{align*}8+(-8)&=0\\8+(-26)&=-18\\-8+(-26)&=-34\end{align*}$$
